newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spanish government bonds ran out of steam late on Friday, after the long future contract failed to reach a new high, dealers said.
The market closed mixed, with the long-end unchanged from yesterday's level and the short-end higher.

"After the market missed its target, we saw a profit-taking wave," a dealer in Madrid said. But, he added, the tone is still positive and "we still saw people buying, even though in the less dangerous segment of the three year bonds".
The 7.80 percent three-year bond closed at 103.21 from 103.15, with a yield at 6.55 percent.
Dealers expect a further flattening of the curve, they said.
"The longer term part of the curve is the one where there is more room to see a drop in yields," a dealer said.
The 10-year spread over German Bunds remained unchanged this morning at 162 basis points and the differential over Btps which was locked at 31 basis points.
